first_missing_criterion: Record-level official/public physical building-footprint Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry for an Exeter building, directly bound to explicit building type/use evidence. The GOV.UK API Catalogue entry for Historic England's National Heritage List for England confirms an official OGL endpoint in EPSG:27700 containing points and polygons and updated daily, but this catalogue window exposes no individual Exeter feature, polygon coordinates, or record-bound type/use payload. Source-area/API metadata was inspected without parcel-progress credit and no individual building record was accepted.
